spec_desc:
- Entry signal: sma crossover. Bullish when the 10-bar sma of the close crosses above the 100-bar sma (it was at or below it on the previous bar and is strictly above it now); bearish on the mirror-image cross below.
- Direction: long only (bearish signals only close longs).

- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

- Position size: a fixed 0.25 of equity per trade.
- Breakeven: once a bar closes at least 1.5 x entry ATR in profit, move the stop to the entry price for the rest of the trade (it never moves back).
- Trailing stop: track the best price of the trade (highest high for longs, lowest low for shorts, starting from the entry price and updated with each bar's high/low while the position is held); the stop sits 4 x entry ATR behind that extreme. The trailing stop only becomes active once the breakeven rule has triggered.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

attempts.text: Drop a Donchian 192-bar breakout model on the 15 trading both ways, capped at one trade per UTC day max. Fire a half size entry when price prints new highs or new lows, sitting with a hard stop 1 ATR away. While running, pyramid up to 2 adds of half size each whenever price moves at least 2 entry ATR in our favor from the last add, capping total size at full size. If we get an opposite signal while in a trade, flip flat.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: Donchian channel breakout. Bullish whenever the close is strictly above the highest high of the 192 bars before the current bar; bearish whenever the close is strictly below the lowest low of those 192 bars. This is a level condition, true on every bar it holds.
- Direction: long and short (a bullish signal opens a long when flat, a bearish one opens a short when flat).
- Position size: start with 0.5 of equity, then pyramid. While in the trade, each time the close is at least 2 x the entry ATR beyond the price of the last add (initially the entry price) in the trade's favour, add another 0.5 (total capped at 1.0), at most 2 add(s) per trade; the add price becomes that bar's close.
- Daily cap: at most 1 new entry per UTC calendar day (by the signal bar's open time); further signals that day are ignored.
- Protective stop 1 x entry ATR away from the entry price (below for longs, above for shorts).
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

Arming, expiry and triggering are checked on every bar, in or out of a position; a newer breakout in either direction replaces the armed setup.
- Direction: long and short (a bullish signal opens a long when flat, a bearish one opens a short when flat).
- Position size: a fixed 0.5 of equity per trade.

An opposite Donchian signal flips us out at the open, and if we hit 256 bars from the signal bar, bail at the open too. Respect a 48-bar cooldown once flat before taking any new entries.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: Donchian channel breakout. Bullish whenever the close is strictly above the highest high of the 48 bars before the current bar; bearish whenever the close is strictly below the lowest low of those 48 bars. This is a level condition, true on every bar it holds.
- Direction: long and short (a bullish signal opens a long when flat, a bearish one opens a short when flat).
- Position size: start with 0.25 of equity, then pyramid. While in the trade, each time the close is at least 2 x the entry ATR beyond the price of the last add (initially the entry price) in the trade's favour, add another 0.25 (total capped at 1.0), at most 1 add(s) per trade; the add price becomes that bar's close.
- Cooldown: after any trade ends, take no new entry for 48 bars, counted from the bar on which you first see yourself flat (entries allowed again from that bar + 48).
- Time stop: if the trade is still open 256 bars after the signal bar, exit at the next open (decide on the bar where bars-since-signal reaches 256).
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.
